business.description: The company reported no revenue from operations for the financial year 2025-26. Subsequent to the financial year ended 31.03.2026, the Company proposed to diversify its business activities into electrical power transmission and distribution projects, underground cabling, rural and urban electrification, renewable energy projects, defence infrastructure, and other infrastructure projects, including irrigation and water management projects, on EPC, turnkey and other contractual basis.

litigation: BSE Limited levied a fine of Rs.60,000 + GST for non-compliance with Regulation 18(1) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 due to omission in disclosing resignation of Audit Committee member

The Company has subsequently rectified the disclosure by filing a revised report and has paid the fine imposed by BSE Limited. Further the Company has submitted a Waiver Application on 22.01.2026 for the same.
